name: Loving Your Son
overview: Scripture teaches that loving your son involves both nurturing and disciplined guidance, recognizing that true love includes timely correction to foster wisdom and obedience. The Proverbs emphasize that sparing the rod is detrimental, while proper chastening reflects genuine love, training a child in the right way so he will remain faithful as he grows. Even when a son is stubborn and rebellious, as described in Deuteronomy, consistent parental authority and correction are necessary to bring him back to the path of righteousness. This balance of love and discipline is essential for raising a son who honors his parents and grows in wisdom.
